Contributing to dragonfarm

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thanks for your interest. Bug reports, documentation fixes, and small features are all welcome. This page says how to set up, test, and send changes.

Reporting a problem

Open an issue with the output of dragon_check(), the code you ran, and what happened. The issue form asks for these. For a training run that went wrong, the log.txt in the run folder (dragon_runs_dir()) is the most useful attachment.

Setting up

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak(c("devtools", "testthat", "pkgdown"))
devtools::load_all()
dragon_check()

dragon_check() builds the Python environment on first use (torch, transformers, peft; 2 to 3 GB) and reports the GPU it found. Everything in inst/python/dragonfarm is plain Python run through that environment; no reticulate objects cross the boundary except strings and JSON.

Running the tests

What Command Needs
R unit tests (about 2,300 expectations) devtools::test() R only, a few minutes
Python unit tests see below the Python environment
Integration tests (real training) Sys.setenv(DRAGONFARM_INTEGRATION = "true"); devtools::test(filter = "integration") a GPU helps; downloads small models

The Python tests use a tiny runner so they work without pytest:

py <- dragonfarm:::dragon_python()
system2(py, "inst/python/tests/run.py", env = "PYTHONPATH=inst/python")

Continuous integration runs the first two on every push and the integration suite on a CPU runner, so a change that passes locally should pass there. It also runs lintr::lint_package() with the correctness checks in .lintr (static analysis, not style); run it before sending a change.

Before you send a change

  • devtools::document() after touching roxygen comments.
  • devtools::check(args = "--as-cran") should be clean. R sources must be ASCII outside comments: write the escape \u203a, not the character.
  • pkgdown::check_pkgdown() if you added an exported function; every exported topic has to appear in the reference index in _pkgdown.yml, and a unit test enforces this.
  • Add a line to NEWS.md for anything a user would notice.
  • Changed how a file is read or chunked (inst/python/dragonfarm/documents.py)? Bump READER_VERSION there. Sets are reused by checksum, so without the bump existing document sets keep the chunks the old code produced. Then run python scripts/retrieval_eval.py with the package’s Python before and after on a few real document sets; it prints hit@1/4/8 for both search modes.
  • Add a test. Shiny modules are tested with shiny::testServer; Python helpers have tests under inst/python/tests.
  • Never commit credentials, API keys, or tokens, including in scripts under scripts/. API keys come from environment variables such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, never from a file in the repository.

Sending it

Fork the repository, make a branch, and open a pull request against main with a short description of what changed and why. Maintainers commit directly to main; outside changes come in through pull requests so the checks run first.

Where things live

Path Contents
R/ the R API, the Shiny modules (mod_*.R), backends, run bookkeeping
inst/python/dragonfarm/ training, evaluation, document ingestion, retrieval, the inference worker
inst/python/tests/ Python unit tests
inst/app/www/ app CSS and JavaScript
inst/extdata/ example tickets and policy documents
vignettes/ the quickstart and the articles on the site
architecture/ design notes written before larger features
scripts/ measurement scripts behind numbers quoted in the docs

Releasing (maintainer)

  1. Bump Version: in DESCRIPTION and change the top NEWS heading to that version. Update cran-comments.md.

  2. R CMD build and R CMD check --as-cran on the tarball: no errors or warnings; explain any note in cran-comments.md.

  3. Submit at https://cran.r-project.org/submit.html. CRAN asks for at most one update every one to two months.

  4. Once CRAN accepts it, tag the release commit and create the GitHub release from that version’s NEWS section, so the repository’s “Latest” release matches CRAN:

    git tag v0.4.0 && git push origin v0.4.0
gh release create v0.4.0 --title "dragonfarm 0.4.0" --notes-file notes.md --latest

  5. Add .9000 to the version for development.

Conduct

Be kind and assume good faith. Harassment or personal attacks in issues, pull requests, or discussions are not acceptable and will be removed.
